property_summary: closeTakeFor always reverts when msg.sender is not the given account (only the account owner may close its take position).
On a freshly deployed, uninitialized product, openTake always reverts for any amount, since position changes require prior initialization (oracle/settle machinery absent).
On a freshly deployed product, any account has an entirely empty position: maker, taker, and maintenance are all zero.

On a freshly deployed (uninitialized) product, openTakeFor must revert for every account and amount, since settlement against an uninitialized controller cannot succeed.
On a freshly deployed, uninitialized product, settle() must revert because syncing against the unset oracle cannot succeed.
